title: Not 128oz.
text:
Not 128oz.. I filled it up with my fridge which measures the water. It is only about 115 fluid ounces. I have another brand that also does not contain the amount of water advertised.
I got it for the carrying handle. My 64oz can be difficult to carry with the small lid handle.
